Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a use tax exemption for items purchased from a nonprofit organization conducting fund-raising activities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a use tax exemption for itemspurchased from a nonprofit organization conducting fund-raisingactivities; and adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply to the use by aconsumer of any property or service otherwise taxable under RCW82.12.020 and purchased by the consumer from a nonprofit organizationor a library, if: (a) The purchase is exempt from sales tax under RCW 82.08.02573; or (b) In the case of an item purchased from an out-of-state sellerthat is not registered with the department for sales tax purposes, thepurchase would have otherwise been exempt from sales tax under RCW82.08.02573. (2) Consumers must retain documentation evidencing theirentitlement to an exemption under this section.
